legacyMaterial.status: Retired from the public site; retained for preservation
legacyMaterial.reason: Fictional oral-history transcripts, demonstration dish dossiers and illustrative photographs must not be presented as community testimony.

historyNotes.nineteenthCenturyMigration: Hari K. Nasta, History of We Bhagnaris, printed pp. 3–4
historyNotes.seaDeparture: History booklet records sea passage; Karachi departure context is supported separately by the community migration article.
historyNotes.housing1954: History booklet printed p. 8 describes the first building of Bhag Co-operative Housing Society. The public copy describes what became Kataria Colony rather than dating the whole colony to 1954.
historyNotes.nameAndLanguage: Community accounts differ about Bhag/Nar/Nari. Do not assert Bhag lies on the Nari River as an established fact. Attribute the Saraiki description to community writers.
